correctness.rationale: For the six-mononomial smooth toric hexagon over Z, the vertex chart has normalized sections (1,u,v,uv²,u²v,u²v²). Hasse order-2 binomial derivatives form an integral 6x6 jet matrix. Independently constructed the entire matrix using binomial coefficients and enumerated all 36 signed 5x5 minors: exactly 18 nonzero, all monomials, and the ideal is exactly (2u²,uv,2v²) because the generators occur among the minors; determinant 0. For 2 invertible this specializes to (u,v)² in each of six vertex charts, so six length-three points total length18; in characteristic2 to (uv), the reduced hexagonal toric boundary, rank3 at vertices/rank4 along nonvertex boundary/rank5 on dense torus. The six boundary lines give degree6, arithmetic genus1 and Hilbert polynomial 6d; differing fiber Hilbert polynomials show nonflatness. Exact characteristic2 rank tests (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1) gave 3,4,4,5. Toric symmetry and gluing are justified by the six lattice vertices rather than finite-field sampling.
